items.title: FischerGPT

story.forWho: Fischer Spindle Group, a Swiss industrial company. This was my master thesis at the University of Zurich (2025).
story.need: An AI assistant that knows the company’s own documents, while every employee only sees what they are allowed to see.
story.did: Built a secure retrieval system (RAG) behind the company chat assistant, with permission-aware search, and showed that it answers at expert level.

items.tags: ai rag chatbot llm enterprise documents master thesis uzh fischer

items.title: Fischer Planning Lab

story.forWho: Fischer Spindle Group. This was my bachelor thesis at FHNW (2023), with a summary, video and the full thesis behind the link.
story.need: Weekly order planning ran on whiteboards, magnets and stickers, and took the team around 7 hours every week.
story.did: Built a touch-friendly planning app for large screens that pulls data from the ERP and the timekeeping system, plus a dashboard for the workers.

items.tags: erp planning web app react python touch bachelor thesis fhnw fischer

items.title: Fischer Spindle Portal
items.tags: portal intranet search mongodb sharepoint sap erp integration company fischer spindles

story.forWho: Fischer Spindle Group, where I worked for 6.5 years and grew from assistant to software developer.
story.need: Information about every spindle and compressor was spread across many systems, so finding anything took time.
story.did: Built one portal where employees find everything about a spindle in one place, connected to MongoDB for spindle data, SharePoint for manuals and datasheets, and SAP for order and quality history.
